newsitem.title: THAILAND: Investors to be exempted from Thai machinery tax.
newsitem.headline: Investors to be exempted from Thai machinery tax.

text.p: Thailand's council of economic ministers on Monday agreed to grant tax exemptions on machinery imported by investors for government-promoted projects covering 16 provinces, including Bangkok.

Amnaj Chanawong, deputy government spokesman, told reporters after an economic ministers meeting that the approval would now be forwarded to the government-run Board of Investment (BOI) for its final approval.
Under the approval, machinery importers in Bangkok and 15 provinces in the central region would be entitled to receive this special incentive, Amnaj said.
